title: Tesla's wireless power and claimed over-unity

tellings.quote: and frankly uh there's are accounts that suggest that or not suggest that state that that Tesla believed that he was even able to achieve so-called overunity.

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla believed he had achieved "over-unity", a machine that puts out more energy than goes into it, according to Kurt McConnell, a former Senate staffer. McConnell tells Michels there are accounts that do not just hint at this but "state" it, though he does not name them. He raises it while talking about Tesla's work on sending power without wires, which, if the claim held, would point to a nearly free source of energy.
